integration_decision.name: READER_VISIBILITY_IS_A_SEPARATE_GATE_FROM_TWO_WRITER_SERIALIZATION
integration_decision.source_finding: Pinned runner.py calls atomic_write_json separately for latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json. Pinned storage.py atomic_write_json performs one os.replace per file. Thus even a future whole-run writer mutex cannot make a reader that opens all three files between replaces observe one atomic generation. The existing two-writer final-state test alone cannot prove reader-visible three-file consistency. This is a source-level conditional multi-file-reader exposure, not proof any production reader consumes all three.
integration_decision.new_runnable_no_network_contract: In an authorized exact-SHA disposable checkout, run a deterministic single-refresh reader interleave first: (1) run real runner.run_once(network=False,as_of_ms=T,local_dir=shared) on empty archive and snapshot three A files; (2) append exactly one PIT-visible rowB using existing FlowObservation fixture, and independently compute B reference in another tmp directory; (3) spawn B with a top-level target wrapping only runner.atomic_write_json: delegate original latest.json write, set Event after_first_replace, then wait release Event with bounded timeout before audit_latest.json; (4) while B paused, parse all three shared files; assert observed latest matches B reference while audit and anata still match A reference, with audit visible/normalized counts and rowB provenance as independent oracles; same as_of_ms is NOT a generation identifier; (5) release B, join/cleanup all children in finally, confirm final triple matches B reference. The intermediate mixed state is a RED baseline for any requirement that readers obtain an atomic three-file bundle; if only anata_latest.json is a supported consumer contract, record that narrower contract rather than invent a production defect. Then execute prior paused-A-before-third-write/B-with-rowB two-writer contract, allowing B to wait under a serialized repair; mixed final generations FAIL, missing controlled overlap/provenance INVALID_TEST, deadlock FAIL.
integration_decision.gate: Do not promote based on writer serialization alone. First identify/confirm whether any authorized reader treats the three files as one snapshot; if yes require generation/manifest or reader snapshot protocol and executed regression. No code changes authorized by Planner A.
